label: Urgency Text
purpose: Display a short, time-sensitive text message to create urgency and drive conversions
_notes: The real schema was completely redesigned since this catalog entry was last written — urgency_type, custom_text, show_icon, icon, style, and color_scheme no longer exist on this block. It is now a single free-text field, 'urgency' (default 'HOT PRODUCT | LOW STOCK'), plus pure layout/visibility settings (visibility, desktop_alignment, mobile_alignment, color_scheme, margins) which are excluded as non-content. Write the entire urgency message as plain text into 'urgency' (e.g. 'Only 3 left in stock!', '12 people are viewing this right now') — it is plain text, NOT richtext, so do not include HTML tags.
